div.div: مِبْرَاةٌ The iron implement, (S,) or knife, (AHn, M, K,) with which one forms, fashions, shapes out, or pares, (AHn, S, M, K,) a bow; (AHn, M, K;) as also ↓ بَرَّآءَةٌ , (K, TA,) with teshdeed and medd, (TA,) or ↓ بَرَآءٌ , (so in a copy of the M,) or ↓ بَرَاةٌ . (CK, and so in a MS. copy of the K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
